title: BJP and ABVP march in Giridih over democracy and voter rolls
seoTitle: Giridih BJP march over democracy and voter

tea.why: Protesters marched to counter allegations made by the opposition regarding the revision of electoral rolls and democracy.
tea.want: Participants demanded an end to opposition-led narratives surrounding electoral rolls and defended the removal of infiltrators from voter lists.
tea.changed: Nov 3, 2026: Hundreds of BJP members and leaders participated in a march in Giridih from Jhanda Maidan to Tower Chowk.

summary: On November 3, 2026, hundreds of members and leaders from the BJP and its student wing ABVP held marches in Jharkhand, with a specific event taking place in Giridih. Organised to counter what leaders described as a false narrative by the Congress and the INDIA bloc regarding democracy and electoral roll updates, the Giridih march began at Jhanda Maidan and covered a distance of approximately 300 metres before concluding at Tower Chowk. Prominent figures such as state BJP president Aditya Sahu, Leader of Opposition Babulal Marandi, and former state president Ravindra Rai participated. Speakers alleged that the opposition was attempting to protect infiltrators by criticizing voter list revisions under the guise of a 'Save Vote' campaign, while highlighting the welfare initiatives of the Modi government. No official police or government counter-response was reported regarding law enforcement actions.
demands: Counter opposition narratives about democracy and electoral rolls
Support the removal of Bangladeshi infiltrators from voter lists
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Hundreds of BJP leaders and workers participated in a march in Giridih led by state BJP president Aditya Sahu.
